fields.summary: Autonomous plan of change set 01M7NWFR in run 01M7QZRN; no owner present, nothing asked. Research: a workflow's [env] reaches processes in three places: internal/run/engine.go stepEnv (command, wait, gate, agent, arbiter/advisor and cleanup steps), internal/api/session_run.go (sessions a run spawns, e.g. a conductor's children; today only when len(def.Env) > 0) and internal/api/ship_build.go shipRunEnv (the watchdog acting on a run from outside). All three build from workflow.Definition.EnvPairs and make {run_tmp} only when UsesRunTmp. {run_tmp} is removed by engine.Run's defer and by run abandon (internal/api/run.go) after cleanup steps run. Claude Code puts its scratch folder under $TMPDIR, so agent scratch lands in {run_tmp} too. Plan: one workflow-package helper giving the run's env with TMPDIR={run_tmp} unless [env] sets TMPDIR, used at all three sites, the folder made whenever the helper names it; then the api side (spawned sessions, abandon) and the docs.
fields.title: Run TMPDIR plan: research pass (autonomous conduct)
